title: Baked Ukrainian Cheese Casserole
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish, this baked casserole is filled with melted cheese and perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine cottage cheese, ricotta cheese, and shredded cheddar cheese.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper.
Add the dry ingredients to the cheese mixture and mix well.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Dot the top of the casserole with melted butter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the casserole is set and the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
